ITEM 1 | Bright red, glossy, fleshy pieces, mostly halved or sliced with a paler white-pink core visible in cuts, some slices about 3-4 cm across, piled and overlapping in a white cereal bowl about 15 cm wide, moist and firm-looking, no cooking signs | 140
ITEM 2 | Small, dark purple-black, clustered drupelets with a slightly matte, bumpy surface, scattered among the red pieces and at the right edge of the bowl, each about 1-1.5 cm, firm and dry-looking | 30
ITEM 3 | Small, round, dark blue-black berries with a glossy, smooth skin and a slight bloom, about 1-1.5 cm each, scattered at the lower left and center of the bowl among the other pieces, firm and whole | 25
